purpose: Mechanism-level test whether raw assignment relation differences survive V4 Deep Sets numeric encoding and predict H20 state differences
source_used_before: PR30 prior test, diagnostic development only; never call this independent confirmation
original_first_action: Existing CP-SAT top two distinct legal plans; common initial state and same future CP-SAT continuation
model: Original frozen V4 event network and RHWM H20/P3
label_usage: Paired real simulator outcomes are offline diagnostic only, never world-model input or candidate selection

hypotheses.H1: Distinct public candidate joins can map to identical Deep Sets numeric token multisets

hypotheses.H3: A tied predicted H20 score can co-occur with distinct paired factual completion times; association not causal proof

endpoints: true H20 state error on available observations
